<p>Activity Level measures a buyer's general activity on G2 by aggregating buyer activity data, such as time spent per page and the total number of pages visited.</p>
<p>The following list includes a description of each Activity Level and recommended actions.</p>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th scope="col">Activity Level</th>
<th scope="col">Description</th>
<th scope="col">Recommended action</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>Low</td>
<td>The buyer is conducting preliminary research but is not yet ready to make a purchase.</td>
<td>Consider adding the buyer to a nurture campaign.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Medium</td>
<td>The buyer is actively researching your product.</td>
<td>Add the buyer to your outreach lists and engage them within a week.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>High</td>
<td>The buyer is in the purchasing process.</td>
<td>Engage with the buyer immediately.</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<section class="warningBox" data-a11y-callout-processed="true" role="note" aria-label="Warning"><div class="title"></div>
<div class="content">
<p>As of June 2022, G2 reports Buying Stage and Activity Level in place of a singular Buyer Intent score. For more information on using Buying Stage and Activity Level to filter Buyer Intent data, refer to the <a href="https://documentation.g2.com/docs/buyer-intent#filters" rel="noopener">Filters</a> section.</p>
<p>G2 updates Buying Stage and Activity Level daily.</p>
</div>
</section>
<h2 id="accessing-g2-buyer-intent-data" class="hyperlink-wrapper-container">Accessing G2 Buyer Intent data<button class="copy-link-btn btn btn-secondary btn-icon" data-heading-id="accessing-g2-buyer-intent-data" aria-label="Copy link to Accessing G2 Buyer Intent data"><i class="fa-regular fa-link-horizontal"></i></button></h2>
<p>To access Buyer Intent data for your product, go to <a href="https://my.g2.com/~/buyer_intent" target="_blank" rel="noopener" data-a11y-ext-processed="true">my.G2<span class="sr-only" style="user-select: none;"> (opens in new tab)</span></a>, then <strong>Buyer Activity</strong> > <strong>Buyer Intent</strong> > <strong>Your signals</strong>.</p>
<p><img src="https://documentation-g2-com-images.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/BI-myG2-buyer-intent-tab.png" alt="buyer intent tab"></p>
<p>G2 populates Buyer Intent data for your product based on the filter criteria in the <em><a href="https://documentation.g2.com/docs/buyer-intent#setting-your-ideal-customer-profile-icp" rel="noopener">Match Your Ideal Customer Profile</a></em> panel. You can view aggregate data about your buyers in the <em><a href="https://documentation.g2.com/docs/buyer-intent#buyer-engagement-highlights" rel="noopener">Buyer Engagement Highlights</a></em> panel, or explore the activity of individual buyer organizations using the <em><a href="https://documentation.g2.com/docs/buyer-intent#buyer-intent-insights" rel="noopener">View Buyer Intent Insights</a></em> table.</p>
<h3 id="setting-your-ideal-customer-profile-icp" class="hyperlink-wrapper-container">Setting your ideal customer profile (ICP)<button class="copy-link-btn btn btn-secondary btn-icon" data-heading-id="setting-your-ideal-customer-profile-icp" aria-label="Copy link to Setting your ideal customer profile (ICP)"><i class="fa-regular fa-link-horizontal"></i></button></h3>
<p>Use the filters in the <em>Match Your Ideal Customer Profile</em> pane to refine the Buyer Intent data displayed.</p>
<p><img src="https://documentation-g2-com-images.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/buyer-intent-new-filters.png" alt="ICP panel"></p>
<h4 id="filters" class="hyperlink-wrapper-container">Filters<button class="copy-link-btn btn btn-secondary btn-icon" data-heading-id="filters" aria-label="Copy link to Filters"><i class="fa-regular fa-link-horizontal"></i></button></h4>
<p>Buyer Intent filters enable you to efficiently target buyers based on your selected criteria, such as your product’s current ICP.</p>
<section class="infoBox" data-a11y-callout-processed="true" role="note" aria-label="Note"><div class="title"></div>
<div class="content">
<p>You can also use the <a href="https://documentation.g2.com/docs/buyer-intent#buyer-intent-reporting" rel="noopener">Buyer Intent Reporting</a> panel to learn more about which organizations are organically researching your product or category.</p>
</div>
</section>
<p>G2 offers the following Buyer Intent data filters:</p>
<ul>
<li><em>Date Range</em>: Choose a default date range, or set a custom range. Custom date ranges cannot be longer than one year.</li>
<li><em>Companies</em>: Search for and select specific organizations to include or exclude.</li>
<li><em>Firmographics and Geographic Data</em>: Define firmographic information, such as market segment, company size, geographic region, or industry.</li>
<li><em>Target Products</em>: Find organizations that showed any intent toward a competitor. This filter considers all signal types.</li>
<li><em>Signals Types</em>: Find organizations that generated specific signal types. You can also refine <em>Compare</em> signals by searching for specific competitors</li>
<li><em>Target Categories</em>: If your product is included in multiple G2 categories, select the category signals you want to include or exclude using the dropdown.</li>
</ul>
<section class="warningBox" data-a11y-callout-processed="true" role="note" aria-label="Warning"><div class="title"></div>
<div class="content">
<p>As of June 2022, G2 reports Buying Stage and Activity Level in place of a singular Buyer Intent score. For more information about these scoring components, refer to the <a href="https://documentation.g2.com/docs/buyer-intent#buying-stage-and-activity-level" rel="noopener">Buying Stage and Activity Level</a> section</p>
<p>G2 has automatically migrated your Buyer Intent scores to the new Activity Level scoring model, enabling you to use the Activity Level filter for historical signals.</p>
<p>Buying Stage is a net new scoring component. When using the Buying Stage filter, ensure that your date range accounts for the June 2022 release date.</p>
</div>
</section>
<h4 id="saved-filters" class="hyperlink-wrapper-container">Saved filters<button class="copy-link-btn btn btn-secondary btn-icon" data-heading-id="saved-filters" aria-label="Copy link to Saved filters"><i class="fa-regular fa-link-horizontal"></i></button></h4>
<p>Once your ICP filters are set, you can save your filter choice for later use. To create a new filter, select <strong>Saved Filter</strong>, enter a name for your filter, then select <strong>Save As</strong>. The title of the filter pane will update from <em>No Saved Filter Selected</em> to the name of your new filter.</p>
<p><img src="https://documentation-g2-com-images.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/buyer-intent-save-new-filter.gif" alt="save filters"></p>
<p>Your saved filters are accessible to any my.G2 users who have access to your product’s Buyer Intent data. To apply a saved filter, select <strong>Save Filters</strong>, then select <strong>Apply Filter</strong>.</p>
<p><img src="https://documentation-g2-com-images.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/buyer-intent-choose-saved-filter.gif" alt="choose saved filter"></p>
<p>To update, rename, or delete your filters, use the icons in the <em>Save Filters</em> panel.</p>
<p><img src="https://github.com/g2-documentation/images/blob/main/buyer-intent-edit-delete-filters%20(1).png?raw=true" alt="modify filters"></p>
<section class="warningBox" data-a11y-callout-processed="true" role="note" aria-label="Warning"><div class="title"></div>
<div class="content">
<p>Other my.G2 users in your organization can modify and delete your saved filters.</p>
</div>
</section>
<h3 id="buyer-intent-reporting" class="hyperlink-wrapper-container">Buyer Intent Reporting<button class="copy-link-btn btn btn-secondary btn-icon" data-heading-id="buyer-intent-reporting" aria-label="Copy link to Buyer Intent Reporting"><i class="fa-regular fa-link-horizontal"></i></button></h3>
<p>The <em>Buyer Intent Reporting</em> panel provides an overview of the Buyer Intent data for your <a href="https://documentation.g2.com/docs/buyer-intent#setting-your-ideal-customer-profile-icp" rel="noopener">ideal customer profile (ICP)</a>, including the competitors your product is most commonly compared to, the Buying Stage and Activity Level distribution for your buyers, and supplemental traffic data for your product's G2 profile and categories.</p>
<p><img src="https://documentation-g2-com-images.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/buyer-intent-reporting.png" alt="modify filters"></p>
<h3 id="buyer-intent-insights" class="hyperlink-wrapper-container">Buyer Intent insights<button class="copy-link-btn btn btn-secondary btn-icon" data-heading-id="buyer-intent-insights" aria-label="Copy link to Buyer Intent insights"><i class="fa-regular fa-link-horizontal"></i></button></h3>
<p><img src="https://documentation-g2-com-images.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/BI-myG2-buyer-intent-insights-table-updated.png" alt="BI insights table"></p>
<p>The <em>View Buyer Intent Insights</em> panel provides detailed, company-level information about your buyers, including:</p>
<ul>
<li><em>Buying Stage</em> and <em>Activity Level</em>: Refer to the <a href="https://documentation.g2.com/docs/buyer-intent#buying-stage-and-activity-level" rel="noopener">Buying Stage and Activity Level</a> section for more information on G2's unique scoring components.</li>
<li><em>Headquarters</em>: The location of the buyer’s company headquarters.</li>
<li><em>Last seen</em>: The amount of time since the buyer’s last Buyer Intent signal for your product.</li>
<li><em>Compared To</em>: The competitors your product was directly compared to in a G2 comparison page. Hover over a logo to reveal the product name.</li>
<li><em>Pageviews</em>: The number of views for each type of Buyer Intent pageview signal. For more information about Buyer Intent pageview signals, refer to the <a href="https://documentation.g2.com/docs/buyer-intent#signal-types" rel="noopener">Signal types</a> section.</li>
<li><em>Unique visitors</em>: The number of unique individuals that triggered Buyer Intent signals for the buyer organization.</li>
<li><em>See Details</em>: Links to a detailed Buyer Intent activity page. Refer to the <a href="https://documentation.g2.com/docs/buyer-intent#detailed-company-activity" rel="noopener">Detailed company activity</a> section for more information.</li>
</ul>
<section class="infoBox" data-a11y-callout-processed="true" role="note" aria-label="Note"><div class="title"></div>
<div class="content">
<p>Certain G2 integrations, such as the <a href="https://documentation.g2.com/docs/linkedin-sales-navigator#viewing-and-saving-your-linkedin-recommended-leads" target="_blank" rel="noopener" data-a11y-ext-processed="true">LinkedIn Sales Navigator<span class="sr-only" style="user-select: none;"> (opens in new tab)</span></a> and <a href="https://documentation.g2.com/docs/g2-bombora-integration#where-bombora-data-appears-in-myg2" target="_blank" rel="noopener" data-a11y-ext-processed="true">Bombora<span class="sr-only" style="user-select: none;"> (opens in new tab)</span></a> integrations, add supplemental information to the Buyer Intent table.</p>
</div>
</section>
<p>To modify your table view, open the <strong>Edit Table View</strong> dropdown, choose the columns you want included in the table, then select <strong>Apply</strong>.</p>
<p><img src="https://documentation-g2-com-images.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/BI-myG2-edit-table-view-updated.gif" alt="edit BI table"></p>
<section class="infoBox" data-a11y-callout-processed="true" role="note" aria-label="Note"><div class="title"></div>
<div class="content">
<p>If you have columns that are hidden from view, a hidden information indicator will be displayed.</p>
<p><img src="https://documentation-g2-com-images.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/BI-myG2-table-hidden-information.png" alt="hidden information BI table"></p>
</div>
</section>
<h4 id="detailed-company-activity" class="hyperlink-wrapper-container">Detailed company activity<button class="copy-link-btn btn btn-secondary btn-icon" data-heading-id="detailed-company-activity" aria-label="Copy link to Detailed company activity"><i class="fa-regular fa-link-horizontal"></i></button></h4>
<p>From the <em>Buyer Intent Insights</em> table, select <strong>See Details</strong> for any buyer organization to go to a company-specific Buyer Intent activity page.</p>
<p><img src="https://documentation-g2-com-images.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/BI-myG2-buyer-intent-see-details.png" alt="see details"></p>
<p>G2 provides a detailed timeline of the Buyer Intent signal history for the buyer organization, including the number of unique visitors generating signals, the geolocation of the individual buyers, and specific information about the Buyer Intent signal.</p>
<p>G2 also includes supplemental data about the buyer organization, such as the company’s website, firmographic information, and links to their social media accounts.</p>
<h4 id="firmographic-analytics" class="hyperlink-wrapper-container">Firmographic analytics<button class="copy-link-btn btn btn-secondary btn-icon" data-heading-id="firmographic-analytics" aria-label="Copy link to Firmographic analytics"><i class="fa-regular fa-link-horizontal"></i></button></h4>
<p>From the <em>View Buyer Intent Insights</em> panel, select the <strong>View Firmographic Analytics</strong> tab for aggregate distribution data about the headquarter location and company size of your buyers, represented as bar charts.</p>
<p><img src="https://documentation-g2-com-images.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/BI-myG2-buyer-intent-insights-firmographics.gif" alt="company information analytics"></p>
<h2 id="intent-studio-beta" class="hyperlink-wrapper-container">Intent Studio (beta)<button class="copy-link-btn btn btn-secondary btn-icon" data-heading-id="intent-studio-beta" aria-label="Copy link to Intent Studio (beta)"><i class="fa-regular fa-link-horizontal"></i></button></h2>
<p>Intent Studio lets you define your ideal customer profile (ICP) and automatically send Buyer Intent signals from matching accounts to selected integrations.</p>
<p><img src="https://cdn.document360.io/1759d01c-b118-4f31-81f7-e4011071a6d4/Images/Documentation/buyer-intent-intent-studio.png?sv=2026-02-06&spr=https&st=2026-09-13T17%3A57%3A49Z&se=2026-09-13T18%3A22%3A49Z&sr=c&sp=r&sig=eil%2BObbka9r%2BMaPtLMLBfTje61K7sSiHW0wgo8ShhEU%3D" alt="intent studio hero image"></p>
<h3 id="configuring-intent-studio" class="hyperlink-wrapper-container">Configuring Intent Studio<button class="copy-link-btn btn btn-secondary btn-icon" data-heading-id="configuring-intent-studio" aria-label="Copy link to Configuring Intent Studio"><i class="fa-regular fa-link-horizontal"></i></button></h3>
<p>To configure Intent Studio, go to <strong>Buyer Activity</strong> > <strong>Your Signals</strong> > <strong>Intent Studio</strong>.</p>
<ol>
<li>In the <em>Define your ICP</em> panel, define the characteristics of accounts you want to target.</li>
<li>Optionally, in the <em>Define Exclusions</em> panel, define exclusions to remove accounts that are not a fit for your business.</li>
<li>In the <em>Apply to Integrations</em> panel, select the integrations that should receive matching Buyer Intent signals.</li>
<li>Select <strong>Save Changes</strong>.</li>
</ol>
<section class="infoBox" data-a11y-callout-processed="true" role="note" aria-label="Note"><div class="title"></div>
<div class="content">
<p>As you configure filters, Intent Studio displays an estimated audience size so you can understand how your criteria affect signal volume and avoid over-filtering.</p>
</div>
</section>
<p>Changes take effect the next business day.</p>
<h3 id="understanding-audience-filtering" class="hyperlink-wrapper-container">Understanding audience filtering<button class="copy-link-btn btn btn-secondary btn-icon" data-heading-id="understanding-audience-filtering" aria-label="Copy link to Understanding audience filtering"><i class="fa-regular fa-link-horizontal"></i></button></h3>
<p>Intent Studio filters Buyer Intent signals only for the integrations selected in the configuration.</p>
<p>Integrations that are not selected continue to receive all Buyer Intent signals.</p>
<section class="infoBox" data-a11y-callout-processed="true" role="note" aria-label="Note"><div class="title"></div>
<div class="content">
<p>Signals from non-matching accounts are not removed from G2.</p>
<p>You can continue to view these signals in myG2, create segments and notifications, and use them in other Buyer Intent workflows.</p>
</div>
</section>
<h2 id="exporting-buyer-intent-data" class="hyperlink-wrapper-container">Exporting Buyer Intent data<button class="copy-link-btn btn btn-secondary btn-icon" data-heading-id="exporting-buyer-intent-data" aria-label="Copy link to Exporting Buyer Intent data"><i class="fa-regular fa-link-horizontal"></i></button></h2>
<p>G2 provides two options for exporting your Buyer Intent data to CSV files: <a href="https://documentation.g2.com/docs/buyer-intent#csv" rel="noopener">CSV</a> and <a href="https://documentation.g2.com/docs/buyer-intent#detail-csv" rel="noopener">Detail CSV</a>.</p>
<p><img src="https://documentation-g2-com-images.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/BI-myG2-download-csv-options.png" alt="csv options"></p>
<section class="warningBox" data-a11y-callout-processed="true" role="note" aria-label="Warning"><div class="title"></div>
<div class="content">
<p>The data included in your CSV depends on the filters set in the <em><a href="https://documentation.g2.com/docs/buyer-intent#setting-your-ideal-customer-profile-icp" rel="noopener">Match Your Ideal Customer Profile</a></em> pane. Larger datasets take longer to generate CSVs.</p>
</div>
</section>
<h3 id="csv" class="hyperlink-wrapper-container">CSV<button class="copy-link-btn btn btn-secondary btn-icon" data-heading-id="csv" aria-label="Copy link to CSV"><i class="fa-regular fa-link-horizontal"></i></button></h3>
<p>Select <strong>Download CSV</strong> to export a CSV in which each row represents a buyer organization.</p>
<p><img src="https://documentation-g2-com-images.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/BI-myG2-CSV-updated.png" alt="csv"></p>
<p>The CSV data resembles the information in the <a href="https://documentation.g2.com/docs/buyer-intent#buyer-intent-insights" rel="noopener">Buyer Intent Insights</a> table, including the headquarter location of the company, the number of pageviews per signal, the Buying Stage and Activity Level, and the date of the most recent Buyer Intent signal for your product.</p>
<section class="infoBox" data-a11y-callout-processed="true" role="note" aria-label="Note"><div class="title"></div>
<div class="content">
<p>The “direct_pageviews” column aggregates product profile, pricing, and sponsored content pageviews to highlight the number of signals that do not feature competitor products.</p>
</div>
</section>
<h3 id="detail-csv" class="hyperlink-wrapper-container">Detail CSV<button class="copy-link-btn btn btn-secondary btn-icon" data-heading-id="detail-csv" aria-label="Copy link to Detail CSV"><i class="fa-regular fa-link-horizontal"></i></button></h3>
<p>Select <strong>Download Detail CSV</strong> to export a CSV in which each row represents an individual Buyer Intent signal.</p>
<p><img src="https://documentation-g2-com-images.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/BI-myG2-detail-csv.png" alt="detail csv"></p>
<p>The Detail CSV data resembles the information on the <a href="https://documentation.g2.com/docs/buyer-intent#detailed-company-activity" rel="noopener">Detailed company activity</a> page, including specific information about each Buyer Intent signal, the geolocation of the individual buyer, and firmographic information about the buyer organization.</p>
<section class="infoBox" data-a11y-callout-processed="true" role="note" aria-label="Note"><div class="title"></div>
<div class="content">
<p>Signals directed at competitor pages are prefixed with <code data-backticks="1">competitive/</code> in the <em>signal_type</em> column (for example, <code data-backticks="1">competitive/pricing</code>, <code data-backticks="1">competitive/profile</code>, or <code data-backticks="1">competitive/compare</code>).</p>
</div>
</section>
<h3 id="data-sources" class="hyperlink-wrapper-container">Data sources<button class="copy-link-btn btn btn-secondary btn-icon" data-heading-id="data-sources" aria-label="Copy link to Data sources"><i class="fa-regular fa-link-horizontal"></i></button></h3>
<p>G2’s proprietary crawling technology uses a collection of publicly-available indicators to determine whether an organization uses certain products.</p>
<p>G2 does not collect, process, or store any personally identifiable data for Stack. Because all data is collected at the organization level, GDPR (and other data privacy legislation) does not apply to Stack customers.</p>
<h2 id="email-notifications-for-buyer-intent-activity" class="hyperlink-wrapper-container">Email notifications for Buyer Intent activity<button class="copy-link-btn btn btn-secondary btn-icon" data-heading-id="email-notifications-for-buyer-intent-activity" aria-label="Copy link to Email notifications for Buyer Intent activity"><i class="fa-regular fa-link-horizontal"></i></button></h2>
<p>Enable members of your organization, including those without my.G2 accounts, to use Buyer Intent data for discovering prospects or keeping track of existing accounts directly from their inbox.</p>
<p><img src="https://documentation-g2-com-images.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/BI-myG2-notification-email-example.png" alt="example email"></p>
<p>Buyer Intent email notifications are sent at a regular interval of your choice, and can be set for specific companies or companies that match your filter criteria.</p>
<p>Notification recipients can access a version of the <em><a href="https://documentation.g2.com/docs/buyer-intent#buyer-intent-insights" rel="noopener">Buyer Intent Insights table</a></em>, populated with your Buyer Intent notification data, and can download the associated <a href="https://documentation.g2.com/docs/buyer-intent#exporting-buyer-intent-data" rel="noopener">CSV and Detail CSV</a>.</p>
<p><img src="https://documentation-g2-com-images.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/BI-myG2-notification-table-updated.png" alt="download csvs"></p>
<h3 id="setting-up-new-notifications-and-filters" class="hyperlink-wrapper-container">Setting up new notifications and filters<button class="copy-link-btn btn btn-secondary btn-icon" data-heading-id="setting-up-new-notifications-and-filters" aria-label="Copy link to Setting up new notifications and filters"><i class="fa-regular fa-link-horizontal"></i></button></h3>
<p>To create a new notification, go to <a href="https://my.g2.com/~/buyer_intent_queries" target="_blank" rel="noopener" data-a11y-ext-processed="true">my.G2<span class="sr-only" style="user-select: none;"> (opens in new tab)</span></a>, then <strong>Buyer Activity</strong> > <strong>Buyer Intent</strong> > <strong>Notifications</strong>. Select <strong>Add notification</strong> to enter the <em>Create a Buyer Intent Notification</em> editor.</p>
<p><img src="https://documentation-g2-com-images.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/BI-myG2-notification-create-new.gif" alt="create new notification"></p>
<p>When setting up your Buyer Intent notifications, it’s important to understand how filtering logic works.</p>
<p><strong>AND logic across multiple filters</strong>: Selections made across different filters (<em>Watch a Target Account List, Filter by Demographics, Filter by Organization Activity</em>) follow AND logic. This means that conditions across filters must be met for a notification to be triggered.</p>
<p><strong>OR logic within individual filters</strong>: Within each filter (e.g., multiple industries, multiple regions, or buyer stages), the logic is OR. This means that if any of the selected options within a filter match, the signal will be included in your notification.</p>
<section class="warningBox" data-a11y-callout-processed="true" role="note" aria-label="Warning"><div class="title"></div>
<div class="content">
<p>Overly specific filters may result in no notifications being received. To ensure you receive relevant alerts, consider broadening your filter criteria.</p>
</div>
</section>
<h4 id="watch-a-target-account-list" class="hyperlink-wrapper-container">Watch a target account list<button class="copy-link-btn btn btn-secondary btn-icon" data-heading-id="watch-a-target-account-list" aria-label="Copy link to Watch a target account list"><i class="fa-regular fa-link-horizontal"></i></button></h4>
<p>Use the <em>Watch a target account list</em> panel to include or exclude Buyer Intent activity for specific companies. Enter matching website domains or company names into the corresponding text boxes, with each unique domain or name entered on a new line.</p>
<p><img src="https://documentation-g2-com-images.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/BI-myG2-notification-account-filter.png" alt="include or exclude account"></p>
<section class="warningBox" data-a11y-callout-processed="true" role="note" aria-label="Warning"><div class="title"></div>
<div class="content">
<p>If using company domains, they must exactly match the company domain on the Buyer Intent signal. If using company names, partial matches are accepted.</p>
</div>
</section>
<h4 id="filter-by-demographics" class="hyperlink-wrapper-container">Filter by demographics<button class="copy-link-btn btn btn-secondary btn-icon" data-heading-id="filter-by-demographics" aria-label="Copy link to Filter by demographics"><i class="fa-regular fa-link-horizontal"></i></button></h4>
<p>To include companies based on your ideal customer profile, add filters to the <em>Filter by demographics</em> panel.</p>
<p><img src="https://documentation-g2-com-images.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/BI-myG2-notification-demographics-updated.gif" alt="firmographic notification filter"></p>
<p>You can filter company headquarter locations by global region using the corresponding checkboxes, or add local region filters by selecting <strong>Add another location</strong>.</p>
<section class="infoBox" data-a11y-callout-processed="true" role="note" aria-label="Note"><div class="title"></div>
<div class="content">
<p>Companies that meet any one of your location criteria will be included in your notification.</p>
<p>Local region filters do not have to correspond to your global region filters. For example, using the <strong>APAC</strong> global region filter and a local region filter for <strong>Illinois, United States</strong> includes companies from either region in your notification.</p>
</div>
</section>
<h4 id="filter-by-organization-activity" class="hyperlink-wrapper-container">Filter by organization activity<button class="copy-link-btn btn btn-secondary btn-icon" data-heading-id="filter-by-organization-activity" aria-label="Copy link to Filter by organization activity"><i class="fa-regular fa-link-horizontal"></i></button></h4>
<p>Use the criteria in the <em>Filter by Organizational Activity</em> panel to find companies that generated specific signal types, are in a particular <em>Buying Stage</em>, or have a minimum <em>Activity Level</em>.</p>
<section class="infoBox" data-a11y-callout-processed="true" role="note" aria-label="Note"><div class="title"></div>
<div class="content">
<p>The <em>Minimum total pageviews</em> field filters buyers based on the total number of Buyer Intent signals generated <a href="https://documentation.g2.com/docs/buyer-intent#set-up-email-notifications" rel="noopener">within your notification interval</a>.</p>
</div>
</section>
<p><img src="https://documentation-g2-com-images.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/buyer-intent-filter-by-organization-activity.png" alt="organization activity notification filter"></p>
<p>Use the <em>Showed Compare Intent Toward</em> filter to find buyers who have compared your product and a competitor’s product.</p>
<p>Use the <em>Showed any Intent toward</em> filter to include signals related to specific products, or the <em>Excluding any Intent toward</em> filter to remove organizations engaging with products that are less relevant to your strategy.</p>
<section class="infoBox" data-a11y-callout-processed="true" role="note" aria-label="Note"><div class="title"></div>
<div class="content">
<p>For more information on Buyer Intent signal types, refer to the <a href="https://documentation.g2.com/docs/buyer-intent#signal-types" rel="noopener">Signal types</a> section.</p>
</div>
</section>
<h4 id="filter-by-category" class="hyperlink-wrapper-container">Filter by category<button class="copy-link-btn btn btn-secondary btn-icon" data-heading-id="filter-by-category" aria-label="Copy link to Filter by category"><i class="fa-regular fa-link-horizontal"></i></button></h4>
<p>If your Buyer Intent subscription includes multiple categories, you can search for and select specific categories to include.</p>
<p><img src="https://documentation-g2-com-images.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/buyer-intent-filter-by-category.png" alt="Image showing the filter by category filter in my.g2 buyer intent"></p>
<p>Select <strong>Only show results that include visits to all selected categories</strong> to include visits that take place across all selected categories.</p>
<h4 id="set-up-email-notifications" class="hyperlink-wrapper-container">Set up email notifications<button class="copy-link-btn btn btn-secondary btn-icon" data-heading-id="set-up-email-notifications" aria-label="Copy link to Set up email notifications"><i class="fa-regular fa-link-horizontal"></i></button></h4>
<p>Add up to 20 email addresses, enter a name for your notification, then set a notification frequency. Each email must be entered on a new line.</p>
<section class="infoBox" data-a11y-callout-processed="true" role="note" aria-label="Note"><div class="title"></div>
<div class="content">
<p>You should consider your notification criteria and signal volume when selecting a frequency.</p>
<p>For example, if you set <em>Minimum total pageviews</em> to 10 and a notification frequency of daily, a buyer organization must trigger 10 Buyer Intent pageview signals in a single day to be included in the notification.</p>
</div>
</section>
<h4 id="previewing-your-notification" class="hyperlink-wrapper-container">Previewing your notification<button class="copy-link-btn btn btn-secondary btn-icon" data-heading-id="previewing-your-notification" aria-label="Copy link to Previewing your notification"><i class="fa-regular fa-link-horizontal"></i></button></h4>
<p>After setting your notification criteria, select <strong>Save</strong> to preview your notification based on the filter criteria and time frame you entered.</p>
<p><img src="https://documentation-g2-com-images.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/BI-myG2-notification-example-updated.png" alt="notification preview"></p>
<p>Select <strong>Send test report</strong> to send a test notification to the email addresses you added in <a href="https://documentation.g2.com/docs/buyer-intent#set-up-email-notifications" rel="noopener">Set up email notifications</a>.</p>
<section class="infoBox" data-a11y-callout-processed="true" role="note" aria-label="Note"><div class="title"></div>
<div class="content">
<p>You can also preview your notification by returning to the <em>Notifications</em> main page, then selecting <strong>See Details</strong> for the notification.</p>
</div>
</section>
<h3 id="modifying-notifications" class="hyperlink-wrapper-container">Modifying notifications<button class="copy-link-btn btn btn-secondary btn-icon" data-heading-id="modifying-notifications" aria-label="Copy link to Modifying notifications"><i class="fa-regular fa-link-horizontal"></i></button></h3>
<p>To make changes to your Buyer Intent notifications, go to <a href="https://my.g2.com/~/buyer_intent_queries" target="_blank" rel="noopener" data-a11y-ext-processed="true">my.G2<span class="sr-only" style="user-select: none;"> (opens in new tab)</span></a>, then <strong>Buyer Activity</strong> > <strong>Buyer Intent</strong> > <strong>Notifications</strong>.</p>
<p>To delete a notification, select the <strong>trash can</strong> icon.</p>
<p><img src="https://documentation-g2-com-images.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/BI-myG2-notification-delete.gif" alt="how to delete notification"></p>
<p>To modify a notification, select the <strong>edit</strong> icon, then adjust the notification criteria.</p>
<p><img src="https://documentation-g2-com-images.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/BI-myG2-notification-edit.gif" alt="how to edit notification"></p>
<p>To disable a notification, select the <strong>edit</strong> icon, then from the <em>Set up email notifications</em> panel, set the <strong>Send notifications</strong> slider to <strong>OFF</strong>.</p>
<p><img src="https://documentation-g2-com-images.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/BI-myG2-enable-email-notifications.gif" alt="disable notification"></p>
</article></d360-article><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----></d360-article-content><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><d360-article-navigator <script nonce="ilmobgaxfwjecpwkhuwoesipjdxqvbpn" id="global-custom-js">(function () {
  // Main lazy loader function
  function lazyLoadImages() {
    const lazyImages = document.querySelectorAll('img.lazy-img[data-src]:not([data-loaded])');

    const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries, obs) => {
      entries.forEach(entry => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          const img = entry.target;
          const src = img.getAttribute('data-src');
          if (src) {
            img.setAttribute('src', src);
            img.setAttribute('loading', 'lazy');
            img.setAttribute('data-loaded', 'true');
            obs.unobserve(img);
          }
        }
      });
    }, {
      rootMargin: '100px',
      threshold: 0.1
    });

    lazyImages.forEach(img => observer.observe(img));
  }

  // Convert <img src="..."> → <img data-src="..."> dynamically
  function convertImagesToLazy() {
    const articleImages = document.querySelectorAll('#articleContent img:not([data-src])');
    articleImages.forEach(img => {
      const src = img.getAttribute('src');
      if (src && src.includes('githubusercontent.com')) {
        img.setAttribute('data-src', src);
        img.removeAttribute('src');
        img.classList.add('lazy-img');
      }
    });
  }

  // Combined setup on article load
  function handleArticleLoad() {
    convertImagesToLazy();
    lazyLoadImages();
  }

  // Run on initial load and every article load
    window.addEventListener('articleload', handleArticleLoad);

  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', handleArticleLoad);
})();

  }

  // === Collapsible Button Logic ===
  function addCollapsibleListener() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.collapsible-wrapper').forEach(wrapper => {
      const button = document.createElement('button');
      button.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      button.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');
      button.textContent = 'Show';
      wrapper.appendChild(button);

      const collapsible = wrapper.querySelector('.collapsible');
      button.addEventListener('click', () => {
        collapsible.classList.toggle('active');
        const isActive = collapsible.classList.contains('active');
        button.textContent = isActive ? 'Hide' : 'Show';
        button.setAttribute('aria-expanded', isActive);
        if (!isActive) {
          wrapper.scrollIntoView({ block: "start" });
        }
      });

      button.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
        if (e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'Enter') {
          e.preventDefault();
          button.click();
        }
      });
    });
  }

  function shouldAttachCollapsible() {
    const url = window.location.href;

    const video = document.querySelector('.vidyard-player-embed');

    const clientID = tracker?.get('clientId');
    if (clientID) {
      video.setAttribute('data-vyemail', clientID + '@clientid.com');

    links.forEach(link => {
      const isExternal = !link.href.includes(window.location.hostname);
      if (isExternal && !link.target) {
        link.setAttribute("target", "_blank");
        link.setAttribute("rel", "noopener noreferrer");
      }
    });
  };

  // Wait for page load
  window.addEventListener("load", () => {
    setTargetBlank();

    // Observe DOM changes for dynamically loaded links
    const observer = new MutationObserver(setTargetBlank);
    observer.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  });

00","conditionalBlockJsonString":"","hasConditionalBlock":false,"unpublishedVersion":0,"aiArticleCreationStatus":0,"isUpdateCrossReference":false,"availableLanguages":[],"isCollabEditorSave":false,"importDocumentStatus":0,"customFields":[],"readingTime":15,"articleContentForSsr":"\u003Cp>G2 Buyer Intent captures enriched data about buyers researching your product across G2. Buyer Intent signals are triggered by a variety of actions, including interacting with your product profile page, comparing your product to a competitor, or viewing alternatives to a product in a shared G2 product category. This data enables your sales, marketing, and customer success teams to identify where an organization is on their buyer journey.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Csection class=\"infoBox\">\u003Cdiv class=\"title\">\u003C\u002Fdiv>\n\u003Cdiv class=\"content\">\n\u003Cp>To discover which platforms can be used for building G2's Buyer Intent data into your existing platforms and workflows, refer to the \u003Ca href=\"https:\u002F\u002Fdocumentation.g2.com\u002Fdocs\u002Fabout-g2-integrations\" rel=\"noopener\">Integrations\u003C\u002Fa> documentation.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003C\u002Fdiv>\n\u003C\u002Fsection>\n\u003Ch2>Basics of G2 Buyer Intent\u003C\u002Fh2>\n\u003Ch3>Confirming your Buyer Intent signal access\u003C\u002Fh3>\n\u003Cp>Your product’s G2 plan determines the types of Buyer Intent signals you receive.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Csection class=\"infoBox\">\u003Cdiv class=\"title\">\u003C\u002Fdiv>\n\u003Cdiv class=\"content\">\n\u003Cp>G2 sends Buyer Intent signals at the product level. If your organization has multiple G2-listed products, each product that you want to receive Buyer Intent signals must have its own subscription. For more information on switching between your products in my.G2, refer to the \u003Ca href=\"\u002Fdocs\u002Fbuyer-intent#confirming-product-access\" rel=\"noopener\">Confirming product access\u003C\u002Fa> section.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003C\u002Fdiv>\n\u003C\u002Fsection>\n\u003Cp>To find the signals available with your current plan:\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Col>\n\u003Cli>Go to \u003Ca href=\"https:\u002F\u002Fmy.g2.com\u002F~\u002Fupgrade\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener\">my.G2\u003C\u002Fa>, then \u003Cstrong>Account\u003C\u002Fstrong> > \u003Cstrong>Upgrade\u003C\u002Fstrong>.\u003C\u002Fli>\n\u003Cli>Your product’s plan is highlighted by a \u003Cem>CURRENT PLAN\u003C\u002Fem> banner. Refer to the \u003Cem>Buyer Intent\u003C\u002Fem> section of this table to confirm the signals your product receives.\u003C\u002Fli>\n\u003C\u002Fol>\n\u003Csection class=\"infoBox\">\u003Cdiv class=\"title\">\u003C\u002Fdiv>\n\u003Cdiv class=\"content\">\n\u003Cp>Buyer Intent includes research activity from G2, Capterra, Software Advice, and GetApp. As a result, some products may experience an increase in Buyer Intent signal volume and the number of companies represented in Buyer Intent insights.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>If you are interested in receiving more Buyer Intent signals than your current plan offers, please contact your G2 representative.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003C\u002Fdiv>\n\u003C\u002Fsection>\n\u003Ch3>Signal types\u003C\u002Fh3>\n\u003Cp>Each Buyer Intent signal represents a unique buyer interaction on G2. The following table describes the signals G2 offers.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Ctable>\n\u003Cthead>\n\u003Ctr>\n\u003Cth>Signal\u003C\u002Fth>\n\u003Cth>Description\u003C\u002Fth>\n\u003C\u002Ftr>\n\u003C\u002Fthead>\n\u003Ctbody>\n\u003Ctr>\n\u003Ctd>Profile\u003C\u002Ftd>\n\u003Ctd>A buyer viewed your \u003Ca href=\"https:\u002F\u002Fwww.g2.com\u002Fproducts\u002Fg2-seller-solutions\u002Freviews\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener\">G2 product profile\u003C\u002Fa>. \u003Cbr>\u003Cbr>This activity indicates that the buyer is specifically researching your product. Refer to the \u003Ca href=\"https:\u002F\u002Fdocumentation.g2.com\u002Fdocs\u002Fproduct-information\" rel=\"noopener\">Product Information\u003C\u002Fa> documentation for more information on updating your G2 profile.\u003C\u002Ftd>\n\u003C\u002Ftr>\n\u003Ctr>\n\u003Ctd>Pricing\u003C\u002Ftd>\n\u003Ctd>A buyer viewed the \u003Ca href=\"https:\u002F\u002Fwww.g2.com\u002Fproducts\u002Fg2-seller-solutions\u002Fpricing\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener\">pricing page\u003C\u002Fa> of your G2 profile. \u003Cbr>\u003Cbr>This activity indicates that the buyer is evaluating your product in the context of their budget. You should ensure that  \u003Ca href=\"https:\u002F\u002Fdocumentation.g2.com\u002Fdocs\u002Fpackages-pricing\" rel=\"noopener\">pricing is added to your product profile\u003C\u002Fa> and consider creating a \u003Ca href=\"https:\u002F\u002Fdocumentation.g2.com\u002Fdocs\u002Fg2-deals\" rel=\"noopener\">G2 Deal\u003C\u002Fa> to push these buyers further down the funnel.\u003C\u002Ftd>\n\u003C\u002Ftr>\n\u003Ctr>\n\u003Ctd>Alternatives\u003C\u002Ftd>\n\u003Ctd>A buyer viewed a G2 \u003Ca href=\"https:\u002F\u002Fwww.g2.com\u002Fproducts\u002Fg2-seller-solutions\u002Fcompetitors\u002Falternatives\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener\">alternatives page\u003C\u002Fa> for your product or a competitor’s product in your subscribed category. \u003Cbr>\u003Cbr>For alternatives pages featuring a competitor’s product, this activity can indicate that the buyer is seeking alternatives for a product in your category, but your product is not necessarily being compared directly.\u003C\u002Ftd>\n\u003C\u002Ftr>\n\u003Ctr>\n\u003Ctd>Category\u003C\u002Ftd>\n\u003Ctd>A buyer viewed a G2 \u003Ca href=\"https:\u002F\u002Fwww.g2.com\u002Fcategories\u002Ftechnology-review-platforms\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener\">category page\u003C\u002Fa> that includes your product. \u003Cbr>\u003Cbr>G2 categorizes products based on a number of factors, including similar functionality and use case.\u003C\u002Ftd>\n\u003C\u002Ftr>\n\u003Ctr>\n\u003Ctd>Compare\u003C\u002Ftd>\n\u003Ctd>A buyer viewed a G2 \u003Ca href=\"https:\u002F\u002Fwww.g2.com\u002Fcompare\u002Fcapterra-vs-g2-seller-solutions\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener\">comparison page\u003C\u002Fa> that included your product. \u003Cbr>\u003Cbr>This activity indicates the buyer is directly comparing your product to a competitor’s product.\u003C\u002Ftd>\n\u003C\u002Ftr>\n\u003Ctr>\n\u003Ctd>Sponsored content\u003C\u002Ftd>\n\u003Ctd>A buyer viewed an advertisement for your product on G2.com. \u003Cbr>\u003Cbr>This signal includes the G2 page where your advertisement was loaded, such as on a competitor’s product profile or category page.\u003C\u002Ftd>\n\u003C\u002Ftr>\n\u003Ctr>\n\u003Ctd>Licensed content\u003C\u002Ftd>\n\u003Ctd>A buyer viewed one of your licensed G2 reports. \u003Cbr>\u003Cbr>This activity indicates that a buyer is interacting with the licensed G2 content you have provided to them. For more information, refer to the \u003Ca href=\"https:\u002F\u002Fdocumentation.g2.com\u002Fdocs\u002Freport-library\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener\">Report Library\u003C\u002Fa> documentation.\u003C\u002Ftd>\n\u003C\u002Ftr>\n\u003Ctr>\n\u003Ctd>Reference page\u003C\u002Ftd>\n\u003Ctd>A buyer viewed one of your G2 \u003Ca href=\"https:\u002F\u002Fwww.g2.com\u002Fproducts\u002Fg2-seller-solutions\u002Freferences\u002F2021-intent-data-references\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener\">Reference pages\u003C\u002Fa>. \u003Cbr>\u003Cbr>This activity indicates that a buyer is interacting with the G2 content you have provided them. For more information, refer to the \u003Ca href=\"https:\u002F\u002Fdocumentation.g2.com\u002Fdocs\u002Freference-pages\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener\">Reference Pages\u003C\u002Fa> documentation.\u003C\u002Ftd>\n\u003C\u002Ftr>\n\u003Ctr>\n\u003Ctd>Competitive\u003C\u002Ftd>\n\u003Ctd>A buyer viewed a pricing, profile, or compare page for a competing product in a shared G2 category. This activity indicates interest in competitor products and can reveal category-level research trends. Competitive signals are based on buyer activity directed at competing products in your category.\u003C\u002Ftd>\n\u003C\u002Ftr>\n\u003C\u002Ftbody>\n\u003C\u002Ftable>\n\u003Csection class=\"infoBox\">\u003Cdiv class=\"title\">\u003C\u002Fdiv>\n\u003Cdiv class=\"content\">\n\u003Cp>When viewing the detailed company activity page, you’ll see these as pricing \u002F profile \u002F compare signals directed toward competing products.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003C\u002Fdiv>\n\u003C\u002Fsection>\n\u003Csection class=\"warningBox\">\u003Cdiv class=\"title\">\u003C\u002Fdiv>\n\u003Cdiv class=\"content\">\n\u003Cp>Not all G2 plans receive Buyer Intent signals, and some plans receive more signals than others. For more information, refer to the \u003Ca href=\"\u002Fdocs\u002Fbuyer-intent#confirming-your-buyer-intent-signal-access\" rel=\"noopener\">Confirming your Buyer Intent signal access\u003C\u002Fa> section.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003C\u002Fdiv>\n\u003C\u002Fsection>\n\u003Ch3>Buying Stage and Activity Level\u003C\u002Fh3>\n\u003Cp>G2 reports two unique scoring components, \u003Cem>Buying Stage\u003C\u002Fem> and \u003Cem>Activity Level\u003C\u002Fem>, for each of your buyers to provide a clear idea of where a buyer is on their journey and how to effectively engage them.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Csection class=\"infoBox\">\u003Cdiv class=\"title\">\u003C\u002Fdiv>\n\u003Cdiv class=\"content\">\n\u003Cp>Buying Stage and Activity level is calculated for each company based on the signals included in your Buyer Intent subscription.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003C\u002Fdiv>\n\u003C\u002Fsection>\n\u003Ch4>Buying Stage\u003C\u002Fh4>\n\u003Cp>Buying Stage evaluates your buyer's journey across G2 using multiple funnel-dependent factors, including page engagement and signal type.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>The following list includes a description of each Buying Stage and recommended actions.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Ctable>\n\u003Cthead>\n\u003Ctr>\n\u003Cth>Buying Stage\u003C\u002Fth>\n\u003Cth>Description\u003C\u002Fth>\n\u003Cth>Recommended action\u003C\u002Fth>\n\u003C\u002Ftr>\n\u003C\u002Fthead>\n\u003Ctbody>\n\u003Ctr>\n\u003Ctd>Awareness\u003C\u002Ftd>\n\u003Ctd>The buyer is exploring how different products might address their needs, but is not likely to have an in-depth understanding of your product category.\u003C\u002Ftd>\n\u003Ctd>Supply general education materials about your product and attempt to gain an understanding of the buyer’s specific needs.\u003C\u002Ftd>\n\u003C\u002Ftr>\n\u003Ctr>\n\u003Ctd>Consideration\u003C\u002Ftd>\n\u003Ctd>The buyer is considering a product in your category, but has not defined a short list of products.\u003C\u002Ftd>\n\u003Ctd>Demonstrate how your product can directly satisfy their requirements.\u003C\u002Ftd>\n\u003C\u002Ftr>\n\u003Ctr>\n\u003Ctd>Decision\u003C\u002Ftd>\n\u003Ctd>The buyer is ready to purchase a product.\u003C\u002Ftd>\n\u003Ctd>Actively differentiate your product from your competitors.\u003C\u002Ftd>\n\u003C\u002Ftr>\n\u003C\u002Ftbody>\n\u003C\u002Ftable>\n\u003Ch4>Activity Level\u003C\u002Fh4>\n\u003Cp>Activity Level measures a buyer's general activity on G2 by aggregating buyer activity data, such as time spent per page and the total number of pages visited.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>The following list includes a description of each Activity Level and recommended actions.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Ctable>\n\u003Cthead>\n\u003Ctr>\n\u003Cth>Activity Level\u003C\u002Fth>\n\u003Cth>Description\u003C\u002Fth>\n\u003Cth>Recommended action\u003C\u002Fth>\n\u003C\u002Ftr>\n\u003C\u002Fthead>\n\u003Ctbody>\n\u003Ctr>\n\u003Ctd>Low\u003C\u002Ftd>\n\u003Ctd>The buyer is conducting preliminary research but is not yet ready to make a purchase.\u003C\u002Ftd>\n\u003Ctd>Consider adding the buyer to a nurture campaign.\u003C\u002Ftd>\n\u003C\u002Ftr>\n\u003Ctr>\n\u003Ctd>Medium\u003C\u002Ftd>\n\u003Ctd>The buyer is actively researching your product.\u003C\u002Ftd>\n\u003Ctd>Add the buyer to your outreach lists and engage them within a week.\u003C\u002Ftd>\n\u003C\u002Ftr>\n\u003Ctr>\n\u003Ctd>High\u003C\u002Ftd>\n\u003Ctd>The buyer is in the purchasing process.\u003C\u002Ftd>\n\u003Ctd>Engage with the buyer immediately.\u003C\u002Ftd>\n\u003C\u002Ftr>\n\u003C\u002Ftbody>\n\u003C\u002Ftable>\n\u003Csection class=\"warningBox\">\u003Cdiv class=\"title\">\u003C\u002Fdiv>\n\u003Cdiv class=\"content\">\n\u003Cp>As of June 2022, G2 reports Buying Stage and Activity Level in place of a singular Buyer Intent score. For more information on using Buying Stage and Activity Level to filter Buyer Intent data, refer to the \u003Ca href=\"\u002Fdocs\u002Fbuyer-intent#filters\" rel=\"noopener\">Filters\u003C\u002Fa> section.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>G2 updates Buying Stage and Activity Level daily.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003C\u002Fdiv>\n\u003C\u002Fsection>\n\u003Ch2>Accessing G2 Buyer Intent data\u003C\u002Fh2>\n\u003Cp>To access Buyer Intent data for your product, go to \u003Ca href=\"https:\u002F\u002Fmy.g2.com\u002F~\u002Fbuyer_intent\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener\">my.G2\u003C\u002Fa>, then \u003Cstrong>Buyer Activity\u003C\u002Fstrong> > \u003Cstrong>Buyer Intent\u003C\u002Fstrong> > \u003Cstrong>Your signals\u003C\u002Fstrong>.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cimg src=\"https:\u002F\u002Fdocumentation-g2-com-images.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com\u002FBI-myG2-buyer-intent-tab.png\" alt=\"buyer intent tab\">\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>G2 populates Buyer Intent data for your product based on the filter criteria in the \u003Cem>\u003Ca href=\"\u002Fdocs\u002Fbuyer-intent#setting-your-ideal-customer-profile-icp\" rel=\"noopener\">Match Your Ideal Customer Profile\u003C\u002Fa>\u003C\u002Fem> panel. You can view aggregate data about your buyers in the \u003Cem>\u003Ca href=\"\u002Fdocs\u002Fbuyer-intent#buyer-engagement-highlights\" rel=\"noopener\">Buyer Engagement Highlights\u003C\u002Fa>\u003C\u002Fem> panel, or explore the activity of individual buyer organizations using the \u003Cem>\u003Ca href=\"\u002Fdocs\u002Fbuyer-intent#buyer-intent-insights\" rel=\"noopener\">View Buyer Intent Insights\u003C\u002Fa>\u003C\u002Fem> table.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Ch3>Setting your ideal customer profile (ICP)\u003C\u002Fh3>\n\u003Cp>Use the filters in the \u003Cem>Match Your Ideal Customer Profile\u003C\u002Fem> pane to refine the Buyer Intent data displayed.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cimg src=\"https:\u002F\u002Fdocumentation-g2-com-images.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com\u002Fbuyer-intent-new-filters.png\" alt=\"ICP panel\">\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Ch4>Filters\u003C\u002Fh4>\n\u003Cp>Buyer Intent filters enable you to efficiently target buyers based on your selected criteria, such as your product’s current ICP.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Csection class=\"infoBox\">\u003Cdiv class=\"title\">\u003C\u002Fdiv>\n\u003Cdiv class=\"content\">\n\u003Cp>You can also use the \u003Ca href=\"\u002Fdocs\u002Fbuyer-intent#buyer-intent-reporting\" rel=\"noopener\">Buyer Intent Reporting\u003C\u002Fa> panel to learn more about which organizations are organically researching your product or category.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003C\u002Fdiv>\n\u003C\u002Fsection>\n\u003Cp>G2 offers the following Buyer Intent data filters:\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cul>\n\u003Cli>\u003Cem>Date Range\u003C\u002Fem>: Choose a default date range, or set a custom range. Custom date ranges cannot be longer than one year.\u003C\u002Fli>\n\u003Cli>\u003Cem>Companies\u003C\u002Fem>: Search for and select specific organizations to include or exclude.\u003C\u002Fli>\n\u003Cli>\u003Cem>Firmographics and Geographic Data\u003C\u002Fem>: Define firmographic information, such as market segment, company size, geographic region, or industry.\u003C\u002Fli>\n\u003Cli>\u003Cem>Target Products\u003C\u002Fem>: Find organizations that showed any intent toward a competitor. This filter considers all signal types.\u003C\u002Fli>\n\u003Cli>\u003Cem>Signals Types\u003C\u002Fem>: Find organizations that generated specific signal types. You can also refine \u003Cem>Compare\u003C\u002Fem> signals by searching for specific competitors\u003C\u002Fli>\n\u003Cli>\u003Cem>Target Categories\u003C\u002Fem>: If your product is included in multiple G2 categories, select the category signals you want to include or exclude using the dropdown.\u003C\u002Fli>\n\u003C\u002Ful>\n\u003Csection class=\"warningBox\">\u003Cdiv class=\"title\">\u003C\u002Fdiv>\n\u003Cdiv class=\"content\">\n\u003Cp>As of June 2022, G2 reports Buying Stage and Activity Level in place of a singular Buyer Intent score. For more information about these scoring components, refer to the \u003Ca href=\"\u002Fdocs\u002Fbuyer-intent#buying-stage-and-activity-level\" rel=\"noopener\">Buying Stage and Activity Level\u003C\u002Fa> section\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>G2 has automatically migrated your Buyer Intent scores to the new Activity Level scoring model, enabling you to use the Activity Level filter for historical signals.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>Buying Stage is a net new scoring component. When using the Buying Stage filter, ensure that your date range accounts for the June 2022 release date.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003C\u002Fdiv>\n\u003C\u002Fsection>\n\u003Ch4>Saved filters\u003C\u002Fh4>\n\u003Cp>Once your ICP filters are set, you can save your filter choice for later use. To create a new filter, select \u003Cstrong>Saved Filter\u003C\u002Fstrong>, enter a name for your filter, then select \u003Cstrong>Save As\u003C\u002Fstrong>. The title of the filter pane will update from \u003Cem>No Saved Filter Selected\u003C\u002Fem> to the name of your new filter.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cimg src=\"https:\u002F\u002Fdocumentation-g2-com-images.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com\u002Fbuyer-intent-save-new-filter.gif\" alt=\"save filters\">\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>Your saved filters are accessible to any my.G2 users who have access to your product’s Buyer Intent data. To apply a saved filter, select \u003Cstrong>Save Filters\u003C\u002Fstrong>, then select \u003Cstrong>Apply Filter\u003C\u002Fstrong>.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cimg src=\"https:\u002F\u002Fdocumentation-g2-com-images.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com\u002Fbuyer-intent-choose-saved-filter.gif\" alt=\"choose saved filter\">\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>To update, rename, or delete your filters, use the icons in the \u003Cem>Save Filters\u003C\u002Fem> panel.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cimg src=\"https:\u002F\u002Fgithub.com\u002Fg2-documentation\u002Fimages\u002Fblob\u002Fmain\u002Fbuyer-intent-edit-delete-filters%20(1).png?raw=true\" alt=\"modify filters\">\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Csection class=\"warningBox\">\u003Cdiv class=\"title\">\u003C\u002Fdiv>\n\u003Cdiv class=\"content\">\n\u003Cp>Other my.G2 users in your organization can modify and delete your saved filters.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003C\u002Fdiv>\n\u003C\u002Fsection>\n\u003Ch3>Buyer Intent Reporting\u003C\u002Fh3>\n\u003Cp>The \u003Cem>Buyer Intent Reporting\u003C\u002Fem> panel provides an overview of the Buyer Intent data for your \u003Ca href=\"\u002Fdocs\u002Fbuyer-intent#setting-your-ideal-customer-profile-icp\" rel=\"noopener\">ideal customer profile (ICP)\u003C\u002Fa>, including the competitors your product is most commonly compared to, the Buying Stage and Activity Level distribution for your buyers, and supplemental traffic data for your product's G2 profile and categories.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cimg src=\"https:\u002F\u002Fdocumentation-g2-com-images.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com\u002Fbuyer-intent-reporting.png\" alt=\"modify filters\">\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Ch3>Buyer Intent insights\u003C\u002Fh3>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cimg src=\"https:\u002F\u002Fdocumentation-g2-com-images.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com\u002FBI-myG2-buyer-intent-insights-table-updated.png\" alt=\"BI insights table\">\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>The \u003Cem>View Buyer Intent Insights\u003C\u002Fem> panel provides detailed, company-level information about your buyers, including:\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cul>\n\u003Cli>\u003Cem>Buying Stage\u003C\u002Fem> and \u003Cem>Activity Level\u003C\u002Fem>: Refer to the \u003Ca href=\"\u002Fdocs\u002Fbuyer-intent#buying-stage-and-activity-level\" rel=\"noopener\">Buying Stage and Activity Level\u003C\u002Fa> section for more information on G2's unique scoring components.\u003C\u002Fli>\n\u003Cli>\u003Cem>Headquarters\u003C\u002Fem>: The location of the buyer’s company headquarters.\u003C\u002Fli>\n\u003Cli>\u003Cem>Last seen\u003C\u002Fem>: The amount of time since the buyer’s last Buyer Intent signal for your product.\u003C\u002Fli>\n\u003Cli>\u003Cem>Compared To\u003C\u002Fem>: The competitors your product was directly compared to in a G2 comparison page. Hover over a logo to reveal the product name.\u003C\u002Fli>\n\u003Cli>\u003Cem>Pageviews\u003C\u002Fem>: The number of views for each type of Buyer Intent pageview signal. For more information about Buyer Intent pageview signals, refer to the \u003Ca href=\"\u002Fdocs\u002Fbuyer-intent#signal-types\" rel=\"noopener\">Signal types\u003C\u002Fa> section.\u003C\u002Fli>\n\u003Cli>\u003Cem>Unique visitors\u003C\u002Fem>: The number of unique individuals that triggered Buyer Intent signals for the buyer organization.\u003C\u002Fli>\n\u003Cli>\u003Cem>See Details\u003C\u002Fem>: Links to a detailed Buyer Intent activity page. Refer to the \u003Ca href=\"\u002Fdocs\u002Fbuyer-intent#detailed-company-activity\" rel=\"noopener\">Detailed company activity\u003C\u002Fa> section for more information.\u003C\u002Fli>\n\u003C\u002Ful>\n\u003Csection class=\"infoBox\">\u003Cdiv class=\"title\">\u003C\u002Fdiv>\n\u003Cdiv class=\"content\">\n\u003Cp>Certain G2 integrations, such as the \u003Ca href=\"https:\u002F\u002Fdocumentation.g2.com\u002Fdocs\u002Flinkedin-sales-navigator#viewing-and-saving-your-linkedin-recommended-leads\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener\">LinkedIn Sales Navigator\u003C\u002Fa> and \u003Ca href=\"https:\u002F\u002Fdocumentation.g2.com\u002Fdocs\u002Fg2-bombora-integration#where-bombora-data-appears-in-myg2\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener\">Bombora\u003C\u002Fa> integrations, add supplemental information to the Buyer Intent table.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003C\u002Fdiv>\n\u003C\u002Fsection>\n\u003Cp>To modify your table view, open the \u003Cstrong>Edit Table View\u003C\u002Fstrong> dropdown, choose the columns you want included in the table, then select \u003Cstrong>Apply\u003C\u002Fstrong>.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cimg src=\"https:\u002F\u002Fdocumentation-g2-com-images.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com\u002FBI-myG2-edit-table-view-updated.gif\" alt=\"edit BI table\">\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Csection class=\"infoBox\">\u003Cdiv class=\"title\">\u003C\u002Fdiv>\n\u003Cdiv class=\"content\">\n\u003Cp>If you have columns that are hidden from view, a hidden information indicator will be displayed.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cimg src=\"https:\u002F\u002Fdocumentation-g2-com-images.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com\u002FBI-myG2-table-hidden-information.png\" alt=\"hidden information BI table\">\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003C\u002Fdiv>\n\u003C\u002Fsection>\n\u003Ch4>Detailed company activity\u003C\u002Fh4>\n\u003Cp>From the \u003Cem>Buyer Intent Insights\u003C\u002Fem> table, select \u003Cstrong>See Details\u003C\u002Fstrong> for any buyer organization to go to a company-specific Buyer Intent activity page.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cimg src=\"https:\u002F\u002Fdocumentation-g2-com-images.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com\u002FBI-myG2-buyer-intent-see-details.png\" alt=\"see details\">\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>G2 provides a detailed timeline of the Buyer Intent signal history for the buyer organization, including the number of unique visitors generating signals, the geolocation of the individual buyers, and specific information about the Buyer Intent signal.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>G2 also includes supplemental data about the buyer organization, such as the company’s website, firmographic information, and links to their social media accounts.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Ch4>Firmographic analytics\u003C\u002Fh4>\n\u003Cp>From the \u003Cem>View Buyer Intent Insights\u003C\u002Fem> panel, select the \u003Cstrong>View Firmographic Analytics\u003C\u002Fstrong> tab for aggregate distribution data about the headquarter location and company size of your buyers, represented as bar charts.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cimg src=\"https:\u002F\u002Fdocumentation-g2-com-images.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com\u002FBI-myG2-buyer-intent-insights-firmographics.gif\" alt=\"company information analytics\">\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Ch2>Intent Studio (beta)\u003C\u002Fh2>\n\u003Cp>Intent Studio lets you define your ideal customer profile (ICP) and automatically send Buyer Intent signals from matching accounts to selected integrations.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cimg src=\"https:\u002F\u002Fcdn.document360.io\u002F1759d01c-b118-4f31-81f7-e4011071a6d4\u002FImages\u002FDocumentation\u002Fbuyer-intent-intent-studio.png?sv=2026-02-06&spr=https&st=2026-09-13T17%3A57%3A49Z&se=2026-09-13T18%3A22%3A49Z&sr=c&sp=r&sig=eil%2BObbka9r%2BMaPtLMLBfTje61K7sSiHW0wgo8ShhEU%3D\" alt=\"intent studio hero image\">\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Ch3>Configuring Intent Studio\u003C\u002Fh3>\n\u003Cp>To configure Intent Studio, go to \u003Cstrong>Buyer Activity\u003C\u002Fstrong> > \u003Cstrong>Your Signals\u003C\u002Fstrong> > \u003Cstrong>Intent Studio\u003C\u002Fstrong>.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Col>\n\u003Cli>In the \u003Cem>Define your ICP\u003C\u002Fem> panel, define the characteristics of accounts you want to target.\u003C\u002Fli>\n\u003Cli>Optionally, in the \u003Cem>Define Exclusions\u003C\u002Fem> panel, define exclusions to remove accounts that are not a fit for your business.\u003C\u002Fli>\n\u003Cli>In the \u003Cem>Apply to Integrations\u003C\u002Fem> panel, select the integrations that should receive matching Buyer Intent signals.\u003C\u002Fli>\n\u003Cli>Select \u003Cstrong>Save Changes\u003C\u002Fstrong>.\u003C\u002Fli>\n\u003C\u002Fol>\n\u003Csection class=\"infoBox\">\u003Cdiv class=\"title\">\u003C\u002Fdiv>\n\u003Cdiv class=\"content\">\n\u003Cp>As you configure filters, Intent Studio displays an estimated audience size so you can understand how your criteria affect signal volume and avoid over-filtering.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003C\u002Fdiv>\n\u003C\u002Fsection>\n\u003Cp>Changes take effect the next business day.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Ch3>Understanding audience filtering\u003C\u002Fh3>\n\u003Cp>Intent Studio filters Buyer Intent signals only for the integrations selected in the configuration.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>Integrations that are not selected continue to receive all Buyer Intent signals.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Csection class=\"infoBox\">\u003Cdiv class=\"title\">\u003C\u002Fdiv>\n\u003Cdiv class=\"content\">\n\u003Cp>Signals from non-matching accounts are not removed from G2.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>You can continue to view these signals in myG2, create segments and notifications, and use them in other Buyer Intent workflows.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003C\u002Fdiv>\n\u003C\u002Fsection>\n\u003Ch2>Exporting Buyer Intent data\u003C\u002Fh2>\n\u003Cp>G2 provides two options for exporting your Buyer Intent data to CSV files: \u003Ca href=\"\u002Fdocs\u002Fbuyer-intent#csv\" rel=\"noopener\">CSV\u003C\u002Fa> and \u003Ca href=\"\u002Fdocs\u002Fbuyer-intent#detail-csv\" rel=\"noopener\">Detail CSV\u003C\u002Fa>.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cimg src=\"https:\u002F\u002Fdocumentation-g2-com-images.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com\u002FBI-myG2-download-csv-options.png\" alt=\"csv options\">\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Csection class=\"warningBox\">\u003Cdiv class=\"title\">\u003C\u002Fdiv>\n\u003Cdiv class=\"content\">\n\u003Cp>The data included in your CSV depends on the filters set in the \u003Cem>\u003Ca href=\"\u002Fdocs\u002Fbuyer-intent#setting-your-ideal-customer-profile-icp\" rel=\"noopener\">Match Your Ideal Customer Profile\u003C\u002Fa>\u003C\u002Fem> pane. Larger datasets take longer to generate CSVs.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003C\u002Fdiv>\n\u003C\u002Fsection>\n\u003Ch3>CSV\u003C\u002Fh3>\n\u003Cp>Select \u003Cstrong>Download CSV\u003C\u002Fstrong> to export a CSV in which each row represents a buyer organization.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cimg src=\"https:\u002F\u002Fdocumentation-g2-com-images.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com\u002FBI-myG2-CSV-updated.png\" alt=\"csv\">\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>The CSV data resembles the information in the \u003Ca href=\"\u002Fdocs\u002Fbuyer-intent#buyer-intent-insights\" rel=\"noopener\">Buyer Intent Insights\u003C\u002Fa> table, including the headquarter location of the company, the number of pageviews per signal, the Buying Stage and Activity Level, and the date of the most recent Buyer Intent signal for your product.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Csection class=\"infoBox\">\u003Cdiv class=\"title\">\u003C\u002Fdiv>\n\u003Cdiv class=\"content\">\n\u003Cp>The “direct_pageviews” column aggregates product profile, pricing, and sponsored content pageviews to highlight the number of signals that do not feature competitor products.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003C\u002Fdiv>\n\u003C\u002Fsection>\n\u003Ch3>Detail CSV\u003C\u002Fh3>\n\u003Cp>Select \u003Cstrong>Download Detail CSV\u003C\u002Fstrong> to export a CSV in which each row represents an individual Buyer Intent signal.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cimg src=\"https:\u002F\u002Fdocumentation-g2-com-images.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com\u002FBI-myG2-detail-csv.png\" alt=\"detail csv\">\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>The Detail CSV data resembles the information on the \u003Ca href=\"\u002Fdocs\u002Fbuyer-intent#detailed-company-activity\" rel=\"noopener\">Detailed company activity\u003C\u002Fa> page, including specific information about each Buyer Intent signal, the geolocation of the individual buyer, and firmographic information about the buyer organization.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Csection class=\"infoBox\">\u003Cdiv class=\"title\">\u003C\u002Fdiv>\n\u003Cdiv class=\"content\">\n\u003Cp>Signals directed at competitor pages are prefixed with \u003Ccode data-backticks=\"1\">competitive\u002F\u003C\u002Fcode> in the \u003Cem>signal_type\u003C\u002Fem> column (for example, \u003Ccode data-backticks=\"1\">competitive\u002Fpricing\u003C\u002Fcode>, \u003Ccode data-backticks=\"1\">competitive\u002Fprofile\u003C\u002Fcode>, or \u003Ccode data-backticks=\"1\">competitive\u002Fcompare\u003C\u002Fcode>).\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003C\u002Fdiv>\n\u003C\u002Fsection>\n\u003Ch3>Data sources\u003C\u002Fh3>\n\u003Cp>G2’s proprietary crawling technology uses a collection of publicly-available indicators to determine whether an organization uses certain products.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>G2 does not collect, process, or store any personally identifiable data for Stack. Because all data is collected at the organization level, GDPR (and other data privacy legislation) does not apply to Stack customers.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Ch2>Email notifications for Buyer Intent activity\u003C\u002Fh2>\n\u003Cp>Enable members of your organization, including those without my.G2 accounts, to use Buyer Intent data for discovering prospects or keeping track of existing accounts directly from their inbox.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cimg src=\"https:\u002F\u002Fdocumentation-g2-com-images.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com\u002FBI-myG2-notification-email-example.png\" alt=\"example email\">\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>Buyer Intent email notifications are sent at a regular interval of your choice, and can be set for specific companies or companies that match your filter criteria.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>Notification recipients can access a version of the \u003Cem>\u003Ca href=\"\u002Fdocs\u002Fbuyer-intent#buyer-intent-insights\" rel=\"noopener\">Buyer Intent Insights table\u003C\u002Fa>\u003C\u002Fem>, populated with your Buyer Intent notification data, and can download the associated \u003Ca href=\"\u002Fdocs\u002Fbuyer-intent#exporting-buyer-intent-data\" rel=\"noopener\">CSV and Detail CSV\u003C\u002Fa>.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cimg src=\"https:\u002F\u002Fdocumentation-g2-com-images.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com\u002FBI-myG2-notification-table-updated.png\" alt=\"download csvs\">\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Ch3>Setting up new notifications and filters\u003C\u002Fh3>\n\u003Cp>To create a new notification, go to \u003Ca href=\"https:\u002F\u002Fmy.g2.com\u002F~\u002Fbuyer_intent_queries\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener\">my.G2\u003C\u002Fa>, then \u003Cstrong>Buyer Activity\u003C\u002Fstrong> > \u003Cstrong>Buyer Intent\u003C\u002Fstrong> > \u003Cstrong>Notifications\u003C\u002Fstrong>. Select \u003Cstrong>Add notification\u003C\u002Fstrong> to enter the \u003Cem>Create a Buyer Intent Notification\u003C\u002Fem> editor.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cimg src=\"https:\u002F\u002Fdocumentation-g2-com-images.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com\u002FBI-myG2-notification-create-new.gif\" alt=\"create new notification\">\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>When setting up your Buyer Intent notifications, it’s important to understand how filtering logic works.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>AND logic across multiple filters\u003C\u002Fstrong>: Selections made across different filters (\u003Cem>Watch a Target Account List, Filter by Demographics, Filter by Organization Activity\u003C\u002Fem>) follow AND logic. This means that conditions across filters must be met for a notification to be triggered.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>OR logic within individual filters\u003C\u002Fstrong>: Within each filter (e.g., multiple industries, multiple regions, or buyer stages), the logic is OR. This means that if any of the selected options within a filter match, the signal will be included in your notification.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Csection class=\"warningBox\">\u003Cdiv class=\"title\">\u003C\u002Fdiv>\n\u003Cdiv class=\"content\">\n\u003Cp>Overly specific filters may result in no notifications being received. To ensure you receive relevant alerts, consider broadening your filter criteria.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003C\u002Fdiv>\n\u003C\u002Fsection>\n\u003Ch4>Watch a target account list\u003C\u002Fh4>\n\u003Cp>Use the \u003Cem>Watch a target account list\u003C\u002Fem> panel to include or exclude Buyer Intent activity for specific companies. Enter matching website domains or company names into the corresponding text boxes, with each unique domain or name entered on a new line.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cimg src=\"https:\u002F\u002Fdocumentation-g2-com-images.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com\u002FBI-myG2-notification-account-filter.png\" alt=\"include or exclude account\">\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Csection class=\"warningBox\">\u003Cdiv class=\"title\">\u003C\u002Fdiv>\n\u003Cdiv class=\"content\">\n\u003Cp>If using company domains, they must exactly match the company domain on the Buyer Intent signal. If using company names, partial matches are accepted.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003C\u002Fdiv>\n\u003C\u002Fsection>\n\u003Ch4>Filter by demographics\u003C\u002Fh4>\n\u003Cp>To include companies based on your ideal customer profile, add filters to the \u003Cem>Filter by demographics\u003C\u002Fem> panel.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cimg src=\"https:\u002F\u002Fdocumentation-g2-com-images.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com\u002FBI-myG2-notification-demographics-updated.gif\" alt=\"firmographic notification filter\">\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>You can filter company headquarter locations by global region using the corresponding checkboxes, or add local region filters by selecting \u003Cstrong>Add another location\u003C\u002Fstrong>.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Csection class=\"infoBox\">\u003Cdiv class=\"title\">\u003C\u002Fdiv>\n\u003Cdiv class=\"content\">\n\u003Cp>Companies that meet any one of your location criteria will be included in your notification.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>Local region filters do not have to correspond to your global region filters. For example, using the \u003Cstrong>APAC\u003C\u002Fstrong> global region filter and a local region filter for \u003Cstrong>Illinois, United States\u003C\u002Fstrong> includes companies from either region in your notification.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003C\u002Fdiv>\n\u003C\u002Fsection>\n\u003Ch4>Filter by organization activity\u003C\u002Fh4>\n\u003Cp>Use the criteria in the \u003Cem>Filter by Organizational Activity\u003C\u002Fem> panel to find companies that generated specific signal types, are in a particular \u003Cem>Buying Stage\u003C\u002Fem>, or have a minimum \u003Cem>Activity Level\u003C\u002Fem>.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Csection class=\"infoBox\">\u003Cdiv class=\"title\">\u003C\u002Fdiv>\n\u003Cdiv class=\"content\">\n\u003Cp>The \u003Cem>Minimum total pageviews\u003C\u002Fem> field filters buyers based on the total number of Buyer Intent signals generated \u003Ca href=\"\u002Fdocs\u002Fbuyer-intent#set-up-email-notifications\" rel=\"noopener\">within your notification interval\u003C\u002Fa>.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003C\u002Fdiv>\n\u003C\u002Fsection>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cimg src=\"https:\u002F\u002Fdocumentation-g2-com-images.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com\u002Fbuyer-intent-filter-by-organization-activity.png\" alt=\"organization activity notification filter\">\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>Use the \u003Cem>Showed Compare Intent Toward\u003C\u002Fem> filter to find buyers who have compared your product and a competitor’s product.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>Use the \u003Cem>Showed any Intent toward\u003C\u002Fem> filter to include signals related to specific products, or the \u003Cem>Excluding any Intent toward\u003C\u002Fem> filter to remove organizations engaging with products that are less relevant to your strategy.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Csection class=\"infoBox\">\u003Cdiv class=\"title\">\u003C\u002Fdiv>\n\u003Cdiv class=\"content\">\n\u003Cp>For more information on Buyer Intent signal types, refer to the \u003Ca href=\"\u002Fdocs\u002Fbuyer-intent#signal-types\" rel=\"noopener\">Signal types\u003C\u002Fa> section.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003C\u002Fdiv>\n\u003C\u002Fsection>\n\u003Ch4>Filter by category\u003C\u002Fh4>\n\u003Cp>If your Buyer Intent subscription includes multiple categories, you can search for and select specific categories to include.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cimg src=\"https:\u002F\u002Fdocumentation-g2-com-images.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com\u002Fbuyer-intent-filter-by-category.png\" alt=\"Image showing the filter by category filter in my.g2 buyer intent\">\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>Select \u003Cstrong>Only show results that include visits to all selected categories\u003C\u002Fstrong> to include visits that take place across all selected categories.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Ch4>Set up email notifications\u003C\u002Fh4>\n\u003Cp>Add up to 20 email addresses, enter a name for your notification, then set a notification frequency. Each email must be entered on a new line.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Csection class=\"infoBox\">\u003Cdiv class=\"title\">\u003C\u002Fdiv>\n\u003Cdiv class=\"content\">\n\u003Cp>You should consider your notification criteria and signal volume when selecting a frequency.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>For example, if you set \u003Cem>Minimum total pageviews\u003C\u002Fem> to 10 and a notification frequency of daily, a buyer organization must trigger 10 Buyer Intent pageview signals in a single day to be included in the notification.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003C\u002Fdiv>\n\u003C\u002Fsection>\n\u003Ch4>Previewing your notification\u003C\u002Fh4>\n\u003Cp>After setting your notification criteria, select \u003Cstrong>Save\u003C\u002Fstrong> to preview your notification based on the filter criteria and time frame you entered.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cimg src=\"https:\u002F\u002Fdocumentation-g2-com-images.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com\u002FBI-myG2-notification-example-updated.png\" alt=\"notification preview\">\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>Select \u003Cstrong>Send test report\u003C\u002Fstrong> to send a test notification to the email addresses you added in \u003Ca href=\"\u002Fdocs\u002Fbuyer-intent#set-up-email-notifications\" rel=\"noopener\">Set up email notifications\u003C\u002Fa>.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Csection class=\"infoBox\">\u003Cdiv class=\"title\">\u003C\u002Fdiv>\n\u003Cdiv class=\"content\">\n\u003Cp>You can also preview your notification by returning to the \u003Cem>Notifications\u003C\u002Fem> main page, then selecting \u003Cstrong>See Details\u003C\u002Fstrong> for the notification.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003C\u002Fdiv>\n\u003C\u002Fsection>\n\u003Ch3>Modifying notifications\u003C\u002Fh3>\n\u003Cp>To make changes to your Buyer Intent notifications, go to \u003Ca href=\"https:\u002F\u002Fmy.g2.com\u002F~\u002Fbuyer_intent_queries\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener\">my.G2\u003C\u002Fa>, then \u003Cstrong>Buyer Activity\u003C\u002Fstrong> > \u003Cstrong>Buyer Intent\u003C\u002Fstrong> > \u003Cstrong>Notifications\u003C\u002Fstrong>.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>To delete a notification, select the \u003Cstrong>trash can\u003C\u002Fstrong> icon.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cimg src=\"https:\u002F\u002Fdocumentation-g2-com-images.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com\u002FBI-myG2-notification-delete.gif\" alt=\"how to delete notification\">\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>To modify a notification, select the \u003Cstrong>edit\u003C\u002Fstrong> icon, then adjust the notification criteria.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cimg src=\"https:\u002F\u002Fdocumentation-g2-com-images.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com\u002FBI-myG2-notification-edit.gif\" alt=\"how to edit notification\">\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>To disable a notification, select the \u003Cstrong>edit\u003C\u002Fstrong> icon, then from the \u003Cem>Set up email notifications\u003C\u002Fem> panel, set the
